catalog.status: accepted by the apps; not yet shipped

Slot.sum: A fixed box in a tool row for a part that depends on data arriving after the row is drawn: the call's phase and times, its record or completion, or the time.
Slot.tree: While needs is given and absent, the content is not evaluated: the evaluated node carries waiting: true and no children, and the app draws the box in the loading look, or in the not-kept look once the loading window since the call's answer has passed. needs itself is never in the tree. Without needs, the content always shows.

geo.w: narrow: min(TW(8 zeros, body), W); short: min(TW(12 zeros, body), W); medium: min(TW(24 zeros, body), W); long: min(TW(40 zeros, body), W); fill: W
geo.note: The width counts the digit zero in the row's body style, the way a CSS ch unit does. In a Card row without wrap, Slots take their widths before the row's other fixed children, so a long code or label beside a Slot is cut to what the Slots leave, wherever the Slot sits in the row. The content is laid out in a column at the box's width and clipped to the box; text that doesn't fit ends its last visible line with an ellipsis. Content shorter than the box sits in it the way the row places a child: in a Card row, centred for align center and at the bottom for end, and at the top for start, stretch and anywhere outside a Card row. The box never grows, so a row's height never depends on what arrives later.

states.loading: a moving skeleton filling the box, still when the person asks for reduced motion
states.unavailable: the box still and muted: the record was pruned or never written
states.text: the content's text form, or nothing while loading

Elapsed.sum: How long a call ran, or has been running: a clock the app keeps ticking itself.

geo.note: start and end are Unix milliseconds. It shows (end, or now while end is absent) minus start as m:ss under an hour and h:mm:ss from an hour, capped at 9:59:59, in tabular digits aligned to the box's trailing edge. While end is absent the app ticks it once a second without evaluating the template again.

states.text: the same m:ss or h:mm:ss string

Agent.sum: An agent, drawn by the app from its own list of agents as a creature and a name.

geo.w: min(L(body) + k.gap.s + TW(16 zeros, body), W)
geo.note: The creature fills an L(body) square, then the name, cut with an ellipsis. While a creature loads, the square holds a plain disc. An id the app doesn't know shows the raw id from the box's leading edge, cut the same way, with no creature and no empty square; the box keeps its width.

states.text: the agent's name, or the id

Model.sum: A model, drawn in words from the app's own model names, such as Opus 5.5 · Anthropic.

geo.note: The model's name, cut with an ellipsis. An id the app doesn't know shows the raw id.

states.text: the model's name, or the id

OpenItem.sum: A link in a tool page to an ask, an artifact or a work item, which opens the app's own card for it.

geo.note: The label is body text in the page's prose, measured by the app. It is a link when the id starts with ask_, art_ or wi_ and the app can read the item on the computer that ran the call, and plain text otherwise, never a disabled control.
